overview_description.description: Consumer enterprises have millions of customer support tickets annually. They need to constantly evaluate support agents’ performance and compliance. Typically they evaluate less than 5% of those interactions manually which is slow, expensive and not scalable. Intryc's AI can evaluate 100% of all customer interactions, in real time, at half the cost.

about_short_description.short_description: Intryc employs artificial intelligence to automate the quality assurance process for customer support services.

product.name: AI-Powered Quality Assurance Automation
product.description: Automates the quality assurance process for customer support by evaluating 100% of support tickets using AI, enabling consistent and comprehensive performance reviews.

product.name: Customizable Scorecards and Evaluation Criteria
product.description: Allows organizations to create unlimited custom scorecards and criteria tailored to their specific customer support quality standards and evaluation needs.

product.name: Intelligent Sampling and Workload Management
product.description: Provides automated, rule-based sampling of support tickets and dynamic workload distribution to ensure comprehensive and statistically significant QA coverage.

product.name: Real-Time Performance Analytics and Insights
product.description: Delivers AI-driven analytics and real-time alerts on customer support performance, highlighting key issues, trends, and agent coaching opportunities.

identifier.value: Agent Coaching and Dispute Resolution Tools

product.name: Agent Coaching and Dispute Resolution Tools
product.description: Supports tailored coaching for support agents based on evaluation results and provides context-rich analysis to fairly resolve evaluation disputes.
